summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure holds. The author archive covers six other tissues and contains none of the 12 registered NZO hypothalamus barcodes. All five computations reproduced, and all 63 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes. The corrected proposal excludes a saved GEO reCAPTCHA page as evidence, records publisher full-text access, distinguishes portal rows with usable statistics, and allows reopening on attributable effects or directions alone. It passed the proposal validator.
openIssues: The reviewed sources provide no gene-level author effect or direction for HFHS versus control in NZO hypothalamus. Author concordance and inference remain unassessed.
Individual mouse and cage assignments remain unresolved for the 12 registered libraries.
